data.one_liner: A CLI tool to change your Flutter app display name across multiple platforms.
data.what_it_does: It is a command-line helper tool that updates the launcher and UI display names of a Flutter project across Android, iOS, Web, Windows, and Linux. It reads either CLI arguments or a config block in pubspec.yaml to update the respective platform configuration files.
use_when: You need to change your Flutter app display name across multiple platforms with a single command.
You want to configure your app name once in pubspec.yaml and run the tool without CLI arguments.
avoid_when: You need a tool that automatically renames strings inside your Dart application code like MaterialApp(title: ...).
strengths: Supports multiple platforms including Android, iOS, Web, Windows, and Linux.
Can be run via CLI arguments or configured directly inside pubspec.yaml.
Provides flexible variants for targeting all platforms at once or specific individual platforms.
weaknesses: Mac OS renaming is currently not wired in the tool.
Does not modify app names inside Dart source code files.
data.setup_notes: Add rename_app as a dev_dependency in your pubspec.yaml and run via dart run rename_app:main.
data.minimal_example: dart run rename_app:main all="My App Name"
